# A windowsill planting diary

Record which pots receive morning or afternoon light and note changes after moving them. A small tray keeps watering convenient, while labels prevent confusion between seedlings. Observations over several weeks are more useful than changing every condition after a single dull day.

Use this diary to compare arrangements in the same room. Seasonal light changes complicate comparisons with a previous month. Keep the notes descriptive: where the pot stood, when it was watered and what changed. The diary does not contain species-specific treatment instructions.
